description: Named star combinations (Cách Cục) for detection

combinations.name: Sát Phá Lang
combinations.description: Sát Phá Lang tam hợp: Thất Sát, Phá Quân, Tham Lang always form a Tam Hợp triangle across Mệnh, Tài Bạch, Quan Lộc.
combinations.note: Dynamic, action-oriented. Indicates major life changes and pioneering spirit.

combinations.name: Cơ Nguyệt Đồng Lương
combinations.description: Cơ Nguyệt Đồng Lương gathered in Mệnh or its Tam Hợp.
combinations.note: Stability, intellect, planning. Favorable for structured careers.

combinations.name: Cự Nhật Đồng Cung
combinations.description: Cự Môn and Thái Dương in the same palace.
combinations.note: Eloquent, persuasive. Best in Dần or Thân.

combinations.name: Tử Phủ
combinations.description: Tử Vi and Thiên Phủ in the same palace (Dần or Thân).
combinations.note: Ultimate authority and wealth, though sometimes lonely at the top.

combinations.name: Phủ Tướng
combinations.description: Thiên Phủ and Thiên Tướng in Tam Hợp with Mệnh.

combinations.name: Nhật Nguyệt
combinations.description: Thái Dương and Thái Âm both in favorable positions within Tam Hợp.
combinations.note: Brightness and wealth. Best when both are Miếu/Vượng.

combinations.name: Lộc Mã
combinations.description: Lộc Tồn and Thiên Mã in the same palace.
combinations.note: Wealth through movement, travel, and dynamic business.

combinations.name: Tam Kỳ
combinations.description: Hóa Khoa, Hóa Quyền, and Hóa Lộc all present in the Three Harmonies.
combinations.note: The ultimate protagonist aura — fame, power, and wealth combined.

combinations.name: Xương Khúc
combinations.description: Văn Xương and Văn Khúc together in Mệnh or Tam Hợp.
combinations.note: Literary and artistic talent, academic success.

combinations.name: Tả Hữu
combinations.description: Tả Phụ and Hữu Bật together in Mệnh or Tam Hợp.
combinations.note: Strong support from peers and subordinates.

combinations.name: Khôi Việt
combinations.description: Thiên Khôi and Thiên Việt together in Mệnh or Tam Hợp.
combinations.note: Noble assistance, unexpected help from superiors.

combinations.name: Kình Đà
combinations.description: Kình Dương and Đà La together in Mệnh or Tam Hợp.

combinations.name: Không Kiếp
combinations.description: Địa Không and Địa Kiếp together in Mệnh or Tam Hợp.

combinations.name: Hỏa Linh
combinations.description: Hỏa Tinh and Linh Tinh together in Mệnh or Tam Hợp.

combinations.name: Giáp Sát
combinations.description: A palace flanked (giáp) by Sát Tinh on both sides.
combinations.note: Pressure and constraint from opposing forces.
